ThingDef.label: flow source
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. Every flow pulse it pours a chosen liquid, at a set rate, into the dug channel it stands on or beside, as if a spring fed it from nowhere. Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built. Its liquid, rate and on/off are set from its buttons in development mode.

ThingDef.label: flow sink
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. Every flow pulse it takes liquid out of the dug channel it stands on or beside, at a set rate or as much as there is, and the liquid leaves the map. Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built. Its rate, which liquid it takes, and on/off are set from its buttons in development mode.

ThingDef.label: flow meter
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker that only reads. Every flow pulse it reads the dug channel it stands on or beside (squares, levels held, liquids, net in or out per day) or, with no channel, the natural liquid body there (its stock, and whether it is limitless). Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built. In development mode its reading shows over it.

ThingDef.label: level holder
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. Every flow pulse it pours or takes its liquid, at a set rate, to keep the dug channel beside it at a set fill (or, with no channel, the natural pond it stands by): a pond that never dries or floods. Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built.

ThingDef.label: timer switch
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. It switches the other map markers and the sluices and grates near it on and off by the hour of day, or on a repeating period. Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built.

ThingDef.label: map-edge setter
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. It sets each map edge to automatic, sealed (no water beyond it: a lake touching it is finite and nothing drains there) or drain (the edge always drains and a lake touching it never runs dry). Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built.

ThingDef.label: current painter
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. It gives the water around it a current in a chosen direction, slow or fast, that carries pawns and things like a river's. Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built.

ThingDef.label: liquid thermostat
ThingDef.description: A map maker's marker. It holds the liquid around it at a set temperature: a roofed room over that liquid is warmed or chilled towards it. Placed in development mode only; it cannot be built.
